## Problem Statement

What problem does this feature solve? Who is it for?

> Example: As a Docker user, I want to filter logs by status code so that I can focus on errors only.

## Proposed Solution

Describe the feature and how it should work.

```bash
# If CLI-facing, show the proposed command/flag
planck analyze app.log --filter-status 5xx
```

## Alternatives Considered

Have you considered any workarounds or alternative approaches?

## Additional Context

Any other context, screenshots, or references (e.g. similar tools that do this well).
